description: Extract schema.org structured data from a page: every JSON-LD block (flattening @graph), the list of @types (Product, Article, Recipe, Event, Organization, FAQPage...), up to 30 typed items with their fields (prices, ratings, dates, authors), plus microdata itemtypes.
